mapper.select: SELECT * FROM skill_definition ORDER BY updated_at DESC, skill_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO skill_definition( skill_id, name, description, enabled, tool_ids_json, prompt_markdown ) VALUES( #{skillId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{toolIdsJson}, #{promptMarkdown} )
mapper.update: UPDATE skill_definition SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, tool_ids_json = #{toolIdsJson}, prompt_markdown = #{promptMarkdown}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE skill_id = #{skillId}
